the opposite sex: At fifteen, many teenagers become shy when they have to talk to members of the opposite sex.
十五歲時，許多青少年要和異性說話時都會變得害羞。
the opposite direction: I took the wrong bus and ended up going in the opposite direction, far away from my school.
我搭錯公車，結果往相反方向走，離學校越來越遠。
quite the opposite: I thought the movie would be boring, but quite the opposite, it was the most exciting film I've seen this year.
我以為那部電影會很無聊，但恰恰相反，它是我今年看過最刺激的電影。
opposite to: The bookstore is opposite to the train station, so you can see it as soon as you walk out.
書店在火車站對面，所以你一走出來就看得到。
have the opposite effect: Shouting at a crying child often has the opposite effect and makes the child cry even louder.
對哭鬧的孩子大吼往往產生反效果，讓孩子哭得更大聲。
opposites attract: Jack is quiet and his wife is very talkative, which proves that sometimes opposites attract.
傑克很安靜，他太太卻很健談，這證明有時候異性相吸、個性相反的人會互相吸引。
diametrically opposite: My sister and I have diametrically opposite opinions about music; she loves rock, while I only listen to classical.
我和妹妹對音樂的看法截然相反；她熱愛搖滾，而我只聽古典樂。
be optimistic about the future: Even after losing his job, Mr. Chen tried to be optimistic about the future and started learning new skills.
即使丟了工作，陳先生仍努力對未來樂觀，並開始學習新技能。
cautiously optimistic: The doctor said she was cautiously optimistic that the patient would recover, but more tests were still needed.
醫生說她對病人會康復審慎樂觀，但仍需要更多檢查。
an optimistic estimate: Finishing the whole project in one week is an optimistic estimate; it will probably take at least a month.
一週內完成整個專案是樂觀的估計；它大概至少要花一個月。
remain optimistic: Although our team was losing by ten points, the coach told us to remain optimistic and keep fighting.
雖然我們球隊落後十分，教練告訴我們要保持樂觀，繼續奮戰。
an optional extra: The car comes with a basic radio, but a sunroof is an optional extra that costs another fifty thousand dollars.
這輛車配有基本收音機，但天窗是選配項目，要另外多花五萬元。
optional subjects: Besides the required classes, senior high students can choose optional subjects such as drama or coding.
除了必修課，高中生還可以選擇戲劇或程式設計之類的選修科目。
be optional for: The weekend art class is optional for students, so only those who are interested need to sign up.
週末美術課對學生是選擇性的，所以只有感興趣的人需要報名。
attendance is optional: The teacher said attendance is optional for the review session, but students who come usually get better grades.
老師說複習課出席自由，但來上課的學生通常成績比較好。
an oral exam: In the oral exam, each student had to talk with the teacher in English for five minutes without notes.
在口試中，每位學生都得不看筆記用英文和老師交談五分鐘。
oral tradition: Many old stories of the tribe were passed down through oral tradition, from grandparents to grandchildren, without books.
這個部落的許多古老故事都是透過口述傳統，由祖父母傳給孫子女，沒有書本記載。
oral hygiene: The dentist reminded the children that good oral hygiene, such as brushing twice a day, prevents tooth problems.
牙醫提醒孩子們，良好的口腔衛生，例如一天刷兩次牙，能預防牙齒問題。
an oral agreement: They never signed any contract; they only had an oral agreement, so it was hard to prove what was promised.
他們從未簽過任何合約，只有口頭協議，所以很難證明當初承諾了什麼。
oral history: For the school project, we recorded the oral history of our grandparents, asking them to describe life fifty years ago.
為了學校專題，我們記錄了祖父母的口述歷史，請他們描述五十年前的生活。
organic food: Many parents now buy organic food, which is grown without chemicals, even though it often costs more at the supermarket.
許多家長現在會購買有機食品，它的種植不使用化學藥劑，雖然在超市裡通常比較貴。
organic growth: Instead of buying other companies, the small shop achieved organic growth by slowly attracting more loyal customers.
這家小店不靠收購其他公司，而是慢慢吸引更多忠實顧客，達成自然的有機成長。
organic farming: My uncle switched to organic farming, using no chemical sprays and feeding his soil with natural compost.
我叔叔改做有機農業，不使用化學噴劑，並用天然堆肥滋養土壤。
an organic whole: The teacher said a good essay should be an organic whole, with every paragraph closely connected to the others.
老師說一篇好文章應該是有機的整體，每一段都與其他段落緊密相連。
organic matter: Dead leaves and food waste become organic matter in the soil, which helps plants grow better.
枯葉和廚餘會成為土壤中的有機物，幫助植物長得更好。
an original idea: Instead of copying from the Internet, Amy came up with an original idea of her own for the science fair.
艾美沒有從網路上抄襲，而是為科展想出一個屬於自己的原創的想法。
the original plan: The original plan was to go to the beach, but because of the rain, we watched a movie at home instead.
原來的計畫是去海邊，但因為下雨，我們改在家裡看電影。
in the original: Mr. Wang can read Shakespeare in the original, so he does not need a Chinese translation.
王老師能以原文閱讀莎士比亞，所以他不需要中文翻譯。
an original thinker: Many people called the inventor an original thinker because he always solved problems in ways no one had tried before.
許多人稱這位發明家為有獨創性的思想家，因為他總是用前所未有的方法解決問題。
original sin: In some Christian teachings, original sin means that every person is born with the first sin of Adam and Eve.
在某些基督教教義中，原罪指的是每個人生來就帶著亞當和夏娃所犯的第一個罪。
the original owner: The old bike still has the name of the original owner written under the seat, so we tried to return it.
這台舊腳踏車的座椅下仍寫著原主的名字，所以我們試著把它還回去。
